jobs.occupation: Research Assistant/Doctoral Student (f/m/d) - Chair of Behavioral Accounting (Research-Manager/in)
jobs.employer_name: WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management-1
jobs.description: General informationThe new Chair of Behavioral Accounting ( Prof. Dr. Victor van Pel t) at WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management in Vallendar is dedicated to the empirical and experimental analysis of decision-making behavior in accounting settings. The focus is on behavioral accounting, controlled, online, and field experiments, and contemporary trends like the use of artificial intelligence. Our research examines how controls, performance feedback, and reporting choices shape the judgments and decisions of managers, employees, investors, and other firm stakeholders. WHU has an international orientation, offers an excellent research environment, and has a vibrant doctoral programme. Moreover, our chair is part of the Finance and Accounting Group, which organizes frequent reading groups and research seminars that further strengthen your doctoral training. This position is particularly suited for people (f/m/d) interested in behavioral research, with a focus on accounting questions, and a career in academia.Your mission Research• Conducting independent research in the field of behavioral accounting, in particular on experimental issues in reporting, controls, performance feedback, and the use of artificial intelligence in accounting.• The aim is to present research results at international conferences and publish them in leading journals.Teaching• Collaboration in the implementation and further development of courses in the field of financial and management accounting (e.g. preparation of materials, supervision of students, data analysis or support with experiments).• Opportunity to gradually take on your own teaching responsibilities and further develop your teaching skills as part of your doctoral programme.Doctoral programme• Active participation in WHU’s structured doctoral programme, which includes methodological and theoretical courses, research seminars, and presentations in the doctoral colloquium.• Use of the international research environment for professional and personal development, including access to laboratory and online recruitment resources and support for conference travel.Your profileAcademic background• Above-average master’s degree in accounting, economics, finance or a related area.• Ideally, your master’s thesis was written in a subject area related to behavioral or experimental research.• We particularly value if you’ve finished a preparation track, like a research master or another specialized graduate research program.Technical and methodological skills• Strong mathematical programming, analytical, and critical thinking skills.• Experience with experimental design, statistical inference, and academic research and writing practices.• Proficiency in at least one of the following statistical programming languages: R, Stata, or Python.• Experience with oTree for conducting experiments is a big plus.Research interests• Strong interest in experimental behavioral research, particularly in the areas of accounting.• Interest in topics such as misreporting, performance measurement and feedback, controls, incentives, and contemporary issues like sustainability and the use of AI is particularly welcome.Personal requirements• A passion for learning and scientific research in an international environment.• Excellent written and spoken English proficiency (German proficiency is not required).What we offer Academic EnvironmentWHU has more than 60 faculty members in the fields of management, finance and accounting, economics, entrepreneurship and innovation, marketing and sales, and supply chain management. Research at WHU aims to adhere to three principles: quality, internationality, and practical relevance.WHU is an equal opportunity employer and thus welcomes applications from individuals with diverse backgrounds. We believe in the benefits of diversity and therefore foster an international, inclusive, and inspiring working environment.ContactFor questions please contact:Professor Victor van Peltemail: Victor.vanPelt@whu.eduAbout usAs one of Germany’s top private business schools, WHU is consistently ranked among Europe’s finest. Since its inception in 1984, we have driven excellence and entrepreneurial thinking, producing innovative research that steers progress for all areas of society and industry. At both the Vallendar and Düsseldorf campuses, we empower leaders to become responsible changemakers, guided by integrity, diversity, and strengthened by a deep sense of togetherness.

jobs.description: Creating knowledge. Making a difference. Shaping the future. Every day, over 7,000 employees devote themselves to cutting-edge research and excellent teaching. We share more than a workplace. We share the desire to make a real impact – regionally and internationally. Our day-to-day work is distinguished by diversity, openness and space to pursue one’s ideas. Become a part of our team – in academia, a technical or manual trade, or administration.The Molecular Evolution and Sociobiology Group (AG Gadau) at the Institute for Evolution and Biodiversity (IEB) at the University of Münster, Germany, is seeking to fill the position of aLecturerAkademische Rätin/Akademischer Rat auf Zeit(salary level A 13 LBesO)commencing on 01 January 2027. We are offering a three-year, fixed-term position (100%) with the option to extend by an additional three years. The prospective candidate is required to teach four hours per week during the semester (4 SWS).Your tasks:- Developing an independent, internationally visible and competitive research program in Evolutionary Biology, Molecular Evolution or Chemical Ecology of Hymenoptera- Participating in teaching (4SWS/semester) of Bachelor/Master/PhD Students with the option of developing own teaching modules.- Participation in academic self-administrationOur expectations:- Having fun doing research and teaching in Evolutionary Biology.- A university degree and a PhD in Biology, or a related field is required.- Extensive experience in chemical ecology and either of the following two fields: molecular evolution or evolutionary ecology demonstrated by publications in peer reviewed articles is required.- Excellent command of English is required.- Postdoctoral research in evolutionary biology, evolutionary ecology, or chemical ecology is an advantage but not necessary.- Ideally you have willingness and motivation to work closely with students (BS, MS, PhD) in teaching and supervision.- Applications for Third-Party funding to build an own, sustainable and independent research program in Evolutionary Biology would be welcomed.- A high level of organizational and communication skills and readiness to collaborate on shared projects within the IEB/AG GadauAdvantages for you:- The AG Gadau and the Institute for Evolution and Biodiversity (https://www.uni-muenster.de/Evolution/ (https://www.uni-muenster.de/Evolution/) ) offer a wide range of opportunities for basic research and teaching in various areas of evolutionary biology, evolutionary ecology, bioinformatics, and biodiversity research.- The international and interdisciplinary teams at the IEB and within the AG Gadau foster a collaborative working environment and are actively involved in numerous national and international research. This creates ideal conditions for collaborations within these consortia as well as for independent research projects.-  Appreciation, commitment, openness and respect – values which are important to us.- Our broad range of diverse work-time models offers great flexibility – also when working from home.- If you have family members or young children in your care, our Family Service Office offers concrete support to help you balance your private and professional responsibilities.- As an educational institution, we are deeply committed to offering occupational training and continuing education opportunities tailored to your individual needs.- From A – Z, Aikido to Zumba, our sport and health programmes ensure a healthy work-life balance.The University of Münster strongly supports equal opportunity and diversity (https://www.uni-muenster.de/profil/en/diversity/policy/mission-statement.html) . We welcome all applicants regardless of sex, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion or worldview, disability, age, sexual orientation or gender identity. We are committed to creating family-friendly working conditions.We actively encourage applications by women. Women with equivalent qualifications and academic achievements will be preferentially considered unless these are outweighed by reasons which necessitate the selection of another candidate.If you have any questions, please contact Prof. Jürgen Gadau (gadauj@uni-muenster.de (gadauj@uni-muenster.de) ) or Dr. Lukas Schrader (lukas.schrader@uni-muenster.de (lukas.schrader@uni-muenster.de) ).Are you interested? Then we look forward to receiving your application (CV and 2-3-page description of your research plan) by 28-10-2026 exclusively via our online application portal.For sustainability reasons, we kindly ask you to refrain from submitting paper/printed documents.Universität MünsterProf. Dr. Jürgen GadauFaculty of BiologyInstitute for Evolution and BiodiversityHüfferstr. 148149 Münster https://www.uni-muenster.de/Evolution/index.shtml (https://www.uni-muenster.de/Evolution/index.shtml)Kennziffer: 3.1_2026_09_01

In order to fill a fixed-term position in full-time (39.83 hours/week = 100%) at the earliest possible date, we are looking for severalPostdocs (2 years) (m,f,x)The Cluster of Excellence "CASA: Securing the Digital Society" is funded by DFG for the years 2026-2032 with approximately 53 million euros. CASA aims to strengthen the resilience of our digital society. The emergence of disruptive technologies in recent years, especially artificial intelligence and quantum computers, has caused substantial new challenges for cybersecurity research. In the second funding phase, CASA will specifically address these challenges. Thematic priorities include the security of quantum technologies, protection against Al-based disinformation and societal polarization, and new approaches to defending against ransomware. In addition to technical questions, it also investigates the interaction of human behavior and cybersecurity. Research at CASA, which is based at the Horst Görtz Institute for IT Security, follows a strongly interdisciplinary approach. Researchers from the fields of computerscience, cryptography, electrical engineering, mathematics, and psychology work together in an unique constellation in Europe. This holistic approach is unparalleled and holds the potential for scientific breakthroughs. Ruhr-University Bochum (RUB) and its Faculty of Computer Science offer an excellent environment for aspiring young researchers. 20 years ago, the Horst Görtz Institute for IT Security (HGI) was founded here. lt is now one of Europe's most prestigious institutions for basic computer security research. The HGI maintains extensive networks with leading research institutions worldwide and with media and industry. Moreover, it has produced numerous successful security startups. The pioneering work of the HGI forms the basis for the Cluster of Excellence CASA.Scope: full-timeDuration: fixed-term, 2 yearsStart: at the earliest possible dateApply by:  2026-11-09Your tasks:- Our goal is to attract postdoctoral researchers and enable them to conducttheir research with the mentorship of a PI. We expect that within the durationof this contract, candidates will be able to achieve independent achievementsin research, e.g through publications or joint research endeavours.- Therefore, we are permanently looking for excellent candidateswithoutstanding doctoral degrees in computer science, electrical engineering,mathematics and psychology (preferably with a relationship to technology) orrelated disciplines.Your profile:- An above-average doctoral degree in computer science, electricalengineering, mathematics, psychology (preferably with a relationship totechnology) or related disciplines is mandatory for the application.- Fluent spoken and written English is also required.- In addition, applicants should have basic knowledge of one or more of theresearch areas relevant to CASA: Cryptography, system security, hardwaresecurity, decentralized security, human-centered security, Al and security.- Postdoctoral students should already have published relevant papers attheleading conferences in cryptography and computer security research, aslisted e.g. at http://csrankings.org/.https://jobs.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/jobposting/67220716e3f3ba2e0f3fbc621a18dc39d659de040?ref=AfA (https://jobs.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/jobposting/67220716e3f3ba2e0f3fbc621a18dc39d659de040?ref=AfA)

Who we areWorldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.The opportunityJoin our WLP FO expert development team within the Core Acquiring Tribe at Worldline, where you'll serve as a recognized domain expert for a specific area of the Worldline Pay Front Office authorization and switching systems. Working alongside fellow WLP FO experts and in close collaboration with the WLP FO Architects, this senior role combines deep technical C++ expertise with extensive business knowledge in financial authorization — requiring you to act as the go-to authority within your domain, a best-practices resource for the team, and a trusted bridge between business requirements and technical implementation.Day-to-day responsibilities- Serve as the recognized expert within your specific WLP FO domain — guiding teams and stakeholders through complex technical and business challenges, and acting as the primary point of reference for your area of expertise internally and externally- Collaborate closely with the WLP FO Architects and fellow domain experts to ensure architectural coherence, standards alignment, and consistency of technical decisions across the broader WLP FO platform- Lead and own the development of C++ software solutions within your domain for real-time electronic payment processing and authorization, championing best practices and technical quality- Interpret complex business requirements within your domain and translate them into innovative, scalable technical solutions — proactively identifying risks, gaps, and opportunities, and escalating cross-domain implications to the WLP FO Architects where appropriate- Define and own technical solutions and requirements for new WLP FO functionality within your scope, recommending best practices and driving alignment across product management, software architecture, and key stakeholders- Champion the conceptual and technical integrity of payment authorization features within your domain, leading technical reviews and contributing to quality standards across the wider expert team- Guide and formally mentor junior and mid-level team members on complex technical and business challenges within your domain, serving as the best-practices and quality resource- Lead functional teams or projects within your WLP FO domain, coordinating cross-functional efforts and ensuring alignment with broader organizational objectives in collaboration with the WLP FO ArchitectsWho are we looking forWe look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what's next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:- Recognized expertise in a specific WLP FO domain within payment authorization systems, with extensive experience in IT services and software development, advanced C++ programming skills, and deep knowledge of relational databases/SQL- Proven ability to work collaboratively with architects and fellow domain experts,  contributing deep domain knowledge while maintaining awareness of cross-domain dependencies and architectural standards- Proven ability to guide others through complex technical challenges within your domain — serving as a best-practices authority and quality resource within and beyond the team- Strong business analysis capabilities with a track record of interpreting complex stakeholder requirements and translating them into innovative, scalable technical solutions- Demonstrated experience leading functional teams or projects in Agile environments, managing cross-functional stakeholder expectations in complex international settings- Excellent analytical, conceptual, and communication skills, with the ability to interpret internal and external business challenges and recommend solutions with broad organizational impact- Deep expertise in the electronic payments sector, specifically in acquiring or issuing authorization systems, is strongly preferred- Excellent English skills#LI-AB1Shape the evolutionWe are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own. Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.comWe are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Systemsoftware (Entwicklung, Programmierung, Analyse), Softwaretechnik, Software-Engineering, Programmiersprache C++

Are you passionate about driving energy and sustainability initiatives in an international environment? Do you want to play a key role in improving energy efficiency and operational safety across our global sites? Then you may be the colleague we are looking for to support our sustainability ambitions and drive improvements across our global operations.As QHSE Supervisor - Global based at our plant in Dorsten, you will combine strategic energy management with operational QHSE responsibilities while working closely with local plants, management teams and global stakeholders.Your responsibilities- Take global responsibility for Energy Management across all seven international sites (six in Europe, one in the US) •  Conduct energy reviews, energy audits and general QHSE audits- Define and analyse Energy Performance Indicators (EnPIs)- Develop, implement and monitor initiatives to improve energy efficiency and reduce CO2 emission- Act as local QHSE representative and ensure implementation of ISO systems and other EHS activities- Deliver training and promote awareness on energy and QHSE topics- Collaborate closely with Plant Management, Operational Excellence, Technical Service teams and Production EmployeesYour profile- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field- Experience within Energy Management in a corporate environment • Knowledge about ISO 50001 and preferably ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and ISO 9001- Hands-on mentality combined with a structured and solution-oriented approach- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills- Strong intercultural awareness and ability to work in international environments- Willingness to travel internationally approximately 1–1.5 weeks per month- Fluent in English and German, written and spokenWhat we offerThis is an international role with high impact and ownership, with the opportunity to actively contribute to energy efficiency improvements worldwide. We offer professional and personal development opportunities in a healthy and growing company. You can expect a Danish corporate culture that is built on gratification, trust and initiative. There is an exceptionally pleasant working atmosphere within a supportive team where everyone communicates as equals. This role includes a company car, mobile phone and flexible working arrangements.Are you interested?Does this sound like the right challenge for you? If so, we look forward to receiving your application in English via e-mail to: bewerbungen@genan.comAny questions? Ask Maren Schink, HR Coordinator Germany: msc@genan.comErgänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: Qualitätsprüfung, Qualitätssicherung, Qualitätsmanagementmethoden/-werkzeuge, Qualitätsaudit, Qualitätsmanagement, QualitätsentwicklungZwingend erforderlich: Energiemanagement

Corporate EHS Manager (m/f/d)Safety is our value: At Xella, we shape an appreciative safety culture, maintain open and cross-hierarchical communication, and jointly drive the continuous improvement of our processes and installations with a solution-oriented approach.What you can expect!We passionately care about the safety and health of everyone who works for or with us, because we know that every injury has an impact on their lives. safe work. safe life.- As a Corporate EHS Manager, you will work hand in hand with our international executives and an international team of motivated EHS Managers and can rely on their support.- As part of our Corporate EHS team, you will support sites and regions in Germany and other European countries in shaping their safety culture, introducing central standards, and acting as the first point of contact for our local managing directors and EHS managers. In this context, you will take over the professional leadership and development of the local EHS managers in your region and report directly to the Head of Corporate EHS.- In addition, you will work in international teams on the conceptual design of group-wide safety initiatives and programs (such as our Life Saving Rules), introduce these in individual training programs and workshops with specialists and leaders and support their implementation. You will develop the competencies and soft skills of the responsible individuals in training and coaching sessions in order to continuously improve and strengthen our safety culture.- We will accompany you on this journey and develop your competencies and soft skills with individual and tailored training courses.You can rely on this!- Self-directed development: We support and promote your skills with tailored development plans, continuous training and digital learning opportunities.- Flexible working: The opportunity to work remotely up to 3 days a week and flexible working hours between 6am and 10pm.- Mobility: Company car also for private use and the option to lease a bicycle or e-bike at attractive rates.- Well covered: We support you with a company pension scheme, group accident insurance and through the PME family service.- Work out: Push yourself, not only at work, but also in our gym.- This is what you bring!- Being an EHS Manager is not just a job for you, but a passion with which you infect others?- Then we look forward to hearing from you if you would like to bring all your experience to a changing company as a Senior EHS Manager or take the next step into a challenging position as a junior EHS Manager.- You should have a degree in safety engineering or a comparable university degree with training as an occupational safety specialist. For us, good communication and moderation skills at all levels of the company, as well as a conceptual and structured way of working are just as much a part of your profile as a good command of English (written and spoken) and a moderate willingness to travel.- It would be an advantage if you have sound experience in occupational and plant safety from the manufacturing industry.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: Arbeitsschutz, Unfallverhütung
